newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil CVRD bid specs to be published soon.
newsitem.headline: Brazil CVRD bid specs to be published soon.

text.p: Bid specifications for the sell off of Brazilian mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD) will be published after a privatization council meets to discuss the rules later this month, a BNDES official said.

"The publication of the tender document depends on approval by the National Privatization Council," said Tereza Cristina Aquino, Privatization superintendent at Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES).

The National Privatization Council (CND) is expected to meet on January 28 or January 29 to discuss the bid specifications and set Vale's base price for the block sale of a 40-45 percent voting stake in the firm.
CVRD's privatization is expected to begin in March.
Aquino noted that the tender document, containing CVRD's minimum price, has to be published at least 45 days before the auction takes place.

She also said four companies are due to view information on CVRD in the so-called Data Room this week. Brazil's CSN will be visiting the Data Room for the first time, while local Votorantim group and South Africa's Anglo American Corp have asked for a second viewing.
Aquino said the Data Room will remain open to investors shortly before the auction's date.
